ylt.26:31: `And thou hast made a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen, work of a designer; he maketh it with cherubs;
ylt.26:32: and thou hast put it on four pillars of shittim wood, overlaid with gold, their pegs are of gold, on four sockets of silver.
ylt.26:33: `And thou hast put the vail under the hooks, and hast brought in thither within the vail the ark of the testimony; and the vail hath made a separation for you between the holy and the holy of holies.
ylt.26:34: `And thou hast put the mercy-seat on the ark of the testimony, in the holy of holies.
ylt.26:35: `And thou hast set the table at the outside of the vail, and the candlestick over-against the table on the side of the tabernacle southward, and the table thou dost put on the north side.
ylt.26:36: `And thou hast made a covering for the opening of the tent, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen, work of an embroiderer;
ylt.26:37: and thou hast made for the covering five pillars of shittim wood, and hast overlaid them with gold, their pegs are of gold, and thou hast cast for them five sockets of brass.
ylt.27:1: `And thou hast made the altar of shittim wood, five cubits the length, and five cubits the breadth--the altar is square--and three cubits its height.
ylt.27:2: And thou hast made its horns on its four corners, its horns are of the same, and thou hast overlaid it with brass.
ylt.27:3: And thou hast made its pots to remove its ashes, and its shovels, and its bowls, and its forks, and its fire-pans, even all its vessels thou dost make of brass.
ylt.27:4: `And thou hast made for it a grate of net-work of brass, and hast made on the net four rings of brass on its four extremities,
ylt.27:5: and hast put it under the compass of the altar beneath, and the net hath been unto the middle of the altar.
ylt.27:6: `And thou hast made staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and hast overlaid them with brass.
ylt.27:7: And the staves have been brought into the rings, and the staves have been on the two sides of the altar in bearing it.
ylt.27:8: Hollow with boards thou dost make it, as it hath been shewed thee in the mount, so do they make it.
ylt.27:9: `And thou hast made the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward, hangings for the court of twined linen, a hundred by the cubit is the length for the one side,
ylt.27:10: and its twenty pillars and their twenty sockets are of brass, the pegs of the pillars and their fillets are of silver;
ylt.27:11: and so for the north side in length, hangings of a hundred cubits in length, and its twenty pillars and their twenty sockets are of brass, the pegs of the pillars and their fillets are of silver.
ylt.27:12: `And for the breadth of the court at the west side are hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
ylt.27:13: And for the breadth of the court at the east side, eastward, are fifty cubits.
ylt.27:14: And the hangings at the side are fifteen cubits, their pillars three, and their sockets three.
ylt.27:15: And at the second side are hangings fifteen cubits, their pillars three, and their sockets three.
ylt.27:16: `And for the gate of the court a covering of twenty cubits, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen, work of an embroiderer; their pillars four, their sockets four.
ylt.27:17: All the pillars of the court round about are filleted with silver, their pegs are silver, and their sockets brass.
ylt.27:18: `The length of the court is a hundred by the cubit, and the breadth fifty by fifty, and the height five cubits, of twined linen, and their sockets are brass,
ylt.27:19: even all the vessels of the tabernacle, in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, are brass.
ylt.27:20: `And thou--thou dost command the sons of Israel, and they bring unto thee pure beaten olive oil for the light, to cause the lamp to go up continually;
ylt.27:21: in the tent of meeting, at the outside of the vail, which is over the testimony, doth Aaron--his sons also--arrange it from evening till morning before Jehovah--a statute age-during to their generations, from the sons of Israel.
ylt.28:1: `And thou, bring thou near unto thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from the midst of the sons of Israel, for his being priest to Me, even Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, sons of Aaron;
ylt.28:2: and thou hast made holy garments for Aaron thy brother, for honour and for beauty;
ylt.28:3: and thou--thou dost speak unto all the wise of heart, whom I have filled with a spirit of wisdom, and they have made the garments of Aaron to sanctify him for his being priest to Me.
ylt.28:4: `And these are the garments which they make: a breastplate, and an ephod, and an upper robe, and an embroidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle; yea, they have made holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and for his sons, for his being priest to Me.
ylt.28:5: `And they take the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the linen,
ylt.28:6: and have made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen, work of a designer;
ylt.28:7: it hath two shoulders joining at its two ends, and it is joined.
ylt.28:8: `And the girdle of his ephod which is on him, according to its work, is of the same, of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.
ylt.28:9: `And thou hast taken the two shoham stones, and hast opened on them the names of the sons of Israel;
ylt.28:10: six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the remaining six on the second stone, according to their births;
ylt.28:11: the work of an engraver in stone, openings of a signet, thou dost open the two stones by the names of the sons of Israel; turned round, embroidered with gold, thou dost make them.
ylt.28:12: `And thou hast set the two stones on the shoulders of the ephod--stones of memorial to the sons of Israel--and Aaron hath borne their names before Jehovah, on his two shoulders, for a memorial.
ylt.28:13: `And thou hast made embroidered things of gold,
ylt.28:14: and two chains of pure gold, wreathed work thou dost make them, work of thick bands, and thou hast put the thick chains on the embroidered things.
ylt.28:15: `And thou hast made a breastplate of judgment, work of a designer; according to the work of the ephod thou dost make it; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen thou dost make it;
ylt.28:16: it is square, doubled, a span its length, and a span its breadth.
ylt.28:17: `And thou hast set in it settings of stone, four rows of stone; a row of sardius, topaz, and carbuncle is the first row;
ylt.28:18: and the second row is emerald, sapphire, and diamond;
ylt.28:19: and the third row is opal, agate, and amethyst;
ylt.28:20: and the fourth row is beryl, and onyx, and jasper; embroidered with gold are they in their settings,
ylt.28:21: and the stones are according to the names of the sons of Israel, twelve, according to their names, openings of a signet, each by his name are they for the twelve tribes.
ylt.28:22: `And thou hast made on the breastplate wreathed chains, work of thick bands, of pure gold;
ylt.28:23: and thou hast made on the breastplate two rings of gold, and hast put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate;
ylt.28:24: and thou hast put the two thick bands of gold on the two rings at the ends of the breastplate;
ylt.28:25: and the two ends of the two thick bands thou dost put on the two embroidered things, and thou hast put them on the shoulders of the ephod over-against its face.
ylt.28:26: `And thou hast made two rings of gold, and hast set them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its border, which is over-against the ephod within;
ylt.28:27: and thou hast made two rings of gold, and hast put them on the two shoulders of the ephod, beneath, over-against its front, over-against its joining, above the girdle of the ephod,
ylt.28:28: and they bind the breastplate by its rings unto the rings of the ephod with a ribbon of blue, to be above the girdle of the ephod, and the breastplate is not loosed from the ephod.
ylt.28:29: `And Aaron hath borne the names of the sons of Israel in the breastplate of judgment, on his heart, in his going in unto the sanctuary, for a memorial before Jehovah continually.
ylt.28:30: `And thou hast put unto the breastplate of judgment the Lights and the Perfections, and they have been on the heart of Aaron, in his going in before Jehovah, and Aaron hath borne the judgment of the sons of Israel on his heart before Jehovah continually.
ylt.28:31: `And thou hast made the upper robe of the ephod completely of blue,
ylt.28:32: and the opening for its head hath been in its midst, a border is to its opening round about, work of a weaver, as the opening of a habergeon there is to it; it is not rent.
ylt.28:33: `And thou hast made on its hem pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, on its hem round about, and bells of gold in their midst round about;
ylt.28:34: a bell of gold and a pomegranate, a bell of gold and a pomegranate are on the hems of the upper robe round about.
ylt.28:35: `And it hath been on Aaron to minister in, and its sound hath been heard in his coming in unto the sanctuary before Jehovah, and in his going out, and he doth not die.
ylt.28:36: `And thou hast made a flower of pure gold, and hast opened on it--openings of a signet--`Holy to Jehovah;'
ylt.28:37: and thou hast put it on a blue ribbon, and it hath been on the mitre--over-against the front of the mitre it is;
ylt.28:38: and it hath been on the forehead of Aaron, and Aaron hath borne the iniquity of the holy things which the sons of Israel do hallow, even all their holy gifts; and it hath been on his forehead continually for a pleasing thing for them before Jehovah.
ylt.28:39: `And thou hast embroidered the coat of linen, and hast made a mitre of linen, and a girdle thou dost make--work of an embroiderer.
ylt.28:40: `And for the sons of Aaron thou dost make coats, and thou hast made for them girdles, yea, bonnets thou dost make for them, for honour and for beauty;
ylt.28:41: and thou hast clothed Aaron thy brother with them, and his sons with him, and hast anointed them, and hast consecrated their hand, and hast sanctified them, and they have been priests to Me.
ylt.28:42: `And make thou for them linen trousers to cover the naked flesh: they are from the loins even unto the thighs;
ylt.28:43: and they have been on Aaron and on his sons, in their going in unto the tent of meeting, or in their drawing nigh unto the altar to minister in the sanctuary, and they do not bear iniquity nor have they died; a statute age-during to him, and to his seed after him.
ylt.29:1: `And this is the thing which thou dost to them, to hallow them, for being priests to Me: Take one bullock, a son of the herd, and two rams, perfect ones,
ylt.29:2: and bread unleavened, and cakes unleavened anointed with oil, of fine wheaten flour thou dost make them,
ylt.29:3: and thou hast put them on one basket, and hast brought them near in the basket, also the bullock and the two rams.
ylt.29:4: `And Aaron and his sons thou dost bring near unto the opening of the tent of meeting, and hast bathed them with water;
ylt.29:5: and thou hast taken the garments, and hast clothed Aaron with the coat, and the upper robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and hast girded him with the girdle of the ephod,
ylt.29:6: and hast set the mitre on his head, and hast put the holy crown on the mitre,
ylt.29:7: and hast taken the anointing oil, and hast poured it on his head, and hast anointed him.
ylt.29:8: `And his sons thou dost bring near, and hast clothed them with coats,
ylt.29:9: and hast girded them with a girdle (Aaron and his sons), and hast bound on them bonnets; and the priesthood hath been theirs by a statute age-during, and thou hast consecrated the hand of Aaron, and the hand of his sons,
ylt.29:10: and hast brought near the bullock before the tent of meeting, and Aaron hath laid--his sons also--their hands on the head of the bullock.
ylt.29:11: `And thou hast slaughtered the bullock before Jehovah, at the opening of the tent of meeting,
ylt.29:12: and hast taken of the blood of the bullock, and hast put it on the horns of the altar with thy finger, and all the blood thou dost pour out at the foundation of the altar;
ylt.29:13: and thou hast taken all the fat which is covering the inwards, and the redundance on the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat which is on them, and hast made perfume on the altar;
ylt.29:14: and the flesh of the bullock, and his skin, and his dung, thou dost burn with fire at the outside of the camp; it is a sin-offering.
ylt.29:15: `And the one ram thou dost take, and Aaron and his sons have laid their hands on the head of the ram,
ylt.29:16: and thou hast slaughtered the ram, and hast taken its blood, and hast sprinkled it on the altar round about,
ylt.29:17: and the ram thou dost cut into its pieces, and hast washed its inwards, and its legs, and hast put them on its pieces, and on its head;
ylt.29:18: and thou hast made perfume with the whole ram on the altar. It is a burnt-offering to Jehovah, a sweet fragrance; a fire-offering it is to Jehovah.
ylt.29:19: `And thou hast taken the second ram, and Aaron hath laid--his sons also--their hands on the head of the ram,
ylt.29:20: and thou hast slaughtered the ram, and hast taken of its blood, and hast put on the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the great toe of their right foot, and hast sprinkled the blood on the altar round about;
ylt.29:21: and thou hast taken of the blood which is on the altar, and of the anointing oil, and hast sprinkled on Aaron, and on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him, and he hath been hallowed, he, and his garments, and his sons, and the garments of his sons with him.
ylt.29:22: `And thou hast taken from the ram the fat, and the fat tail, and the fat which is covering the inwards, and the redundance on the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat which is on them, and the right leg, for it is a ram of consecration,
ylt.29:23: and one round cake of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one thin cake out of the basket of the unleavened things which is before Jehovah.
ylt.29:24: `And thou hast set the whole on the hands of Aaron, and on the hands of his sons, and hast waved them--a wave-offering before Jehovah;
ylt.29:25: and thou hast taken them out of their hand, and hast made perfume on the altar beside the burnt-offering, for sweet fragrance before Jehovah; a fire-offering it is to Jehovah.
ylt.29:26: `And thou hast taken the breast from the ram of the consecration which is for Aaron, and hast waved it--a wave-offering before Jehovah, and it hath become thy portion;
ylt.29:27: and thou hast sanctified the breast of the wave-offering, and the leg of the heave-offering, which hath been waved, and which hath been lifted up from the ram of the consecration, of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons;
ylt.29:28: and it hath been for Aaron and for his sons, by a statute age-during from the sons of Israel, for it is a heave-offering; and it is a heave offering from the sons of Israel, from the sacrifices of their peace-offerings--their heave-offering to Jehovah.
ylt.29:29: `And the holy garments which are Aaron's, are for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to consecrate in them their hand;
ylt.29:30: seven days doth the priest in his stead (of his sons) put them on, when he goeth in unto the tent of meeting, to minister in the sanctuary.
ylt.29:31: `And the ram of the consecration thou dost take, and hast boiled its flesh in the holy place;
ylt.29:32: and Aaron hath eaten--his sons also--the flesh of the ram, and the bread which is in the basket, at the opening of the tent of meeting;
ylt.29:33: and they have eaten those things by which there is atonement to consecrate their hand, to sanctify them; and a stranger doth not eat--for they are holy;
ylt.29:34: and if there be left of the flesh of the consecration or of the bread till the morning, then thou hast burned that which is left with fire; it is not eaten, for it is holy.
ylt.29:35: `And thou hast done thus to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded thee; seven days thou dost consecrate their hand;
ylt.29:36: and a bullock, a sin-offering, thou dost prepare daily for the atonements, and thou hast atoned for the altar, in thy making atonement on it, and hast anointed it to sanctify it;
ylt.29:37: seven days thou dost make atonement for the altar, and hast sanctified it, and the altar hath been most holy; all that is coming against the altar is holy.
ylt.29:38: `And this is that which thou dost prepare on the altar; two lambs, sons of a year, daily continually;
ylt.29:39: the one lamb thou dost prepare in the morning, and the second lamb thou dost prepare between the evenings;
ylt.29:40: and a tenth deal of fine flour, mixed with beaten oil, a fourth part of a hin, and a libation, a fourth part of a hin, of wine, is for the one lamb.
ylt.29:41: `And the second lamb thou dost prepare between the evenings; according to the present of the morning, and according to its libation, thou dost prepare for it, for sweet fragrance, a fire-offering, to Jehovah: --
ylt.29:42: a continual burnt-offering for your generations, at the opening of the tent of meeting, before Jehovah, whither I am met with you, to speak unto thee there,
ylt.29:43: and I have met there with the sons of Israel, and it hath been sanctified by My honour.
ylt.29:44: `And I have sanctified the tent of meeting, and the altar, and Aaron and his sons I sanctify for being priests to Me,
ylt.29:45: and I have tabernacled in the midst of the sons of Israel, and have become their God,
ylt.29:46: and they have known that I am Jehovah their God, who hath brought them out of the land of Egypt, that I may tabernacle in their midst; I am Jehovah their God.
ylt.30:1: `And thou hast made an altar for making perfume; of shittim wood thou dost make it;
ylt.30:2: a cubit its length, and a cubit its breadth, (it is square), and two cubits its height; its horns are of the same.
ylt.30:3: `And thou hast overlaid it with pure gold, its top, and its sides round about, and its horns; and thou hast made to it a crown of gold round about;
ylt.30:4: and two rings of gold thou dost make to it under its crown; on its two ribs thou dost make them, on its two sides, and they have become places for staves, to bear it with them.
ylt.30:5: `And thou hast made the staves of shittim wood, and hast overlaid them with gold;
ylt.30:6: and thou hast put it before the vail, which is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy-seat which is over the testimony, whither I am met with thee.
ylt.30:7: `And Aaron hath made perfume on it, perfume of spices, morning by morning; in his making the lamps right he doth perfume it,
ylt.30:8: and in Aaron's causing the lamps to go up between the evenings, he doth perfume it; a continual perfume before Jehovah to your generations.
ylt.30:9: `Ye do not cause strange perfume to go up upon it, and burnt-offering, and present, and libation ye do not pour out on it;
ylt.30:10: and Aaron hath made atonement on its horns, once in a year, by the blood of the sin-offering of atonements; once in a year doth he make atonement for it, to your generations; it is most holy to Jehovah.'
ylt.30:11: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
ylt.30:12: `When thou takest up the sum of the sons of Israel for their numbers, then they have given each an atonement for his soul to Jehovah in their being numbered, and there is no plague among them in their being numbered.
ylt.30:13: `This they do give, every one passing over unto those numbered, half a shekel, by the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel is twenty gerahs); half a shekel is the heave-offering to Jehovah;
ylt.30:14: every one passing over unto those numbered, from a son of twenty years and upwards, doth give the heave-offering of Jehovah;
ylt.30:15: the rich doth not multiply, and the poor doth not diminish from the half-shekel, to give the heave-offering of Jehovah, to make atonement for your souls.
ylt.30:16: `And thou hast taken the atonement-money from the sons of Israel, and hast given it for the service of the tent of meeting; and it hath been to the sons of Israel for a memorial before Jehovah, to make atonement for your souls.'
ylt.30:17: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
ylt.30:18: `And thou hast made a laver of brass (and its base of brass), for washing; and thou hast put it between the tent of meeting and the altar, and hast put water there;
ylt.30:19: and Aaron and his sons have washed at it their hands and their feet,
ylt.30:20: in their going in unto the tent of meeting they wash with water, and die not; or in their drawing nigh unto the altar to minister, to perfume a fire-offering to Jehovah,
ylt.30:21: then they have washed their hands and their feet, and they die not, and it hath been to them a statute age-during, to him and to his seed to their generations.'
ylt.30:22: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
ylt.30:23: `And thou, take to thyself principal spices, wild honey five hundred shekels; and spice-cinnamon, the half of that, two hundred and fifty; and spice-cane two hundred and fifty;
ylt.30:24: and cassia five hundred, by the shekel of the sanctuary, and olive oil a hin;
ylt.30:25: and thou hast made it a holy anointing oil, a compound mixture, work of a compounder; it is a holy anointing oil.
ylt.30:26: `And thou hast anointed with it the tent of meeting, and the ark of the testimony,
ylt.30:27: and the table and all its vessels, and the candlestick and its vessels, and the altar of perfume,
ylt.30:28: and the altar of burnt-offering and all its vessels, and the laver and its base;
ylt.30:29: and thou hast sanctified them, and they have been most holy; all that is coming against them is holy;
ylt.30:30: and Aaron and his sons thou dost anoint, and hast sanctified them for being priests to Me.
ylt.30:31: `And unto the sons of Israel thou dost speak, saying, A holy anointing oil is this to Me, to your generations;
ylt.30:32: on flesh of man it is not poured, and with its proper proportion ye make none like it; it is holy; it is holy to you;
ylt.30:33: a man who compoundeth any like it, or who putteth of it on a stranger--hath even been cut off from his people.'
ylt.30:34: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `Take to thee spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum, spices and pure frankincense; they are part for part;
ylt.30:35: and thou hast made it a perfume, a compound, work of a compounder, salted, pure, holy;
ylt.30:36: and thou hast beaten some of it small, and hast put of it before the testimony, in the tent of meeting, whither I am met with thee; most holy it is to you.
ylt.30:37: `As to the perfume which thou makest, with its proper proportion ye do not make to yourselves, holy it is to thee to Jehovah;
ylt.30:38: a man who maketh any like it--to be refreshed by it--hath even been cut off from his people.'
ylt.31:1: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
ylt.31:2: `See, I have called by name Bezaleel, son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
ylt.31:3: and I fill him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all work,
ylt.31:4: to devise devices to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
ylt.31:5: and in graving of stone for settings, and in graving of wood to work in all work.
ylt.31:6: `And I, lo, I have given with him Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, and in the heart of every wise-hearted one I have given wisdom, and they have made all that which I have commanded thee.
ylt.31:7: `The tent of meeting, and the ark of testimony, and the mercy-seat which is on it, and all the vessels of the tent,
ylt.31:8: and the table and its vessels, and the pure candlestick and all its vessels, and the altar of the perfume,
ylt.31:9: and the altar of the burnt-offering and all its vessels, and the laver and its base,
ylt.31:10: and the coloured garments, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, for acting as priests in;
ylt.31:11: and the anointing oil, and the perfume of the spices for the sanctuary; according to all that I have commanded thee--they do.'
ylt.31:12: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
ylt.31:13: `And thou, speak unto the sons of Israel, saying, Only, My sabbaths ye do keep, for it is a sign between Me and you, to your generations, to know that I, Jehovah, am sanctifying you;
ylt.31:14: and ye have kept the sabbath, for it is holy to you, he who is polluting it is certainly put to death--for any who doeth work in it--that person hath even been cut off from the midst of his people.
ylt.31:15: `Six days is work done, and in the seventh day is a sabbath of holy rest to Jehovah; any who doeth work in the sabbath-day is certainly put to death,
ylt.31:16: and the sons of Israel have observed the sabbath; to keep the sabbath to their generations is a covenant age-during,
ylt.31:17: between Me and the sons of Israel it is a sign--to the age; for six days Jehovah made the heavens and the earth, and in the seventh day He hath ceased, and is refreshed.'
ylt.31:18: And He giveth unto Moses, when He finisheth speaking with him in mount Sinai, two tables of the testimony, tables of stone, written by the finger of God.
ylt.32:1: And the people see that Moses is delaying to come down from the mount, and the people assemble against Aaron, and say unto him, `Rise, make for us gods who go before us, for this Moses--the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt--we have not known what hath happened to him.'
ylt.32:2: And Aaron saith unto them, `Break off the rings of gold which are in the ears of your wives, your sons, and your daughters, and bring in unto me;'
ylt.32:3: and all the people themselves break off the rings of gold which are in their ears, and bring in unto Aaron,
ylt.32:4: and he receiveth from their hand, and doth fashion it with a graving tool, and doth make it a molten calf, and they say, `These thy gods, O Israel, who brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.'
ylt.32:5: And Aaron seeth, and buildeth an altar before it, and Aaron calleth, and saith, `A festival to Jehovah--to-morrow;'
ylt.32:6: and they rise early on the morrow, and cause burnt-offerings to ascend, and bring nigh peace-offerings; and the people sit down to eat and to drink, and rise up to play.
ylt.32:7: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `Go, descend, for thy people whom thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt hath done corruptly,
ylt.32:8: they have turned aside hastily from the way that I have commanded them; they have made for themselves a molten calf, and bow themselves to it, and sacrifice to it, and say, These thy gods, O Israel, who brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.'
ylt.32:9: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `I have seen this people, and lo, it is a stiff-necked people;
ylt.32:10: and now, let Me alone, and My anger doth burn against them, and I consume them, and I make thee become a great nation.'
ylt.32:11: And Moses appeaseth the face of Jehovah his God, and saith, `Why, O Jehovah, doth Thine anger burn against Thy people, whom Thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a strong hand?
ylt.32:12: why do the Egyptians speak, saying, For evil He brought them out to slay them among mountains, and to consume them from off the face of the ground? turn back from the heat of Thine anger, and repent of the evil against Thy people.
ylt.32:13: `Be mindful of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, Thy servants, to whom Thou hast sworn by Thyself, and unto whom Thou speakest: I multiply your seed as stars of the heavens, and all this land, as I have said, I give to your seed, and they have inherited to the age;'
ylt.32:14: and Jehovah repenteth of the evil which He hath spoken of doing to His people.
ylt.32:15: And Moses turneth, and goeth down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony are in his hand, tables written on both their sides, on this and on that are they written;
ylt.32:16: and the tables are the work of God, and the writing is the writing of God, graven on the tables.
ylt.32:17: And Joshua heareth the voice of the people in their shouting, and saith unto Moses, `A noise of battle in the camp!'
ylt.32:18: and he saith, `It is not the voice of the crying of might, nor is it the voice of the crying of weakness--a voice of singing I am hearing.'
ylt.32:19: And it cometh to pass, when he hath drawn near unto the camp, that he seeth the calf, and the dancing, and the anger of Moses burneth, and he casteth out of his hands the tables, and breaketh them under the mount;
ylt.32:20: and he taketh the calf which they have made, and burneth it with fire, and grindeth until it is small, and scattereth on the face of the waters, and causeth the sons of Israel to drink.
ylt.32:21: And Moses saith unto Aaron, `What hath this people done to thee, that thou hast brought in upon it a great sin?'
ylt.32:22: and Aaron saith, `Let not the anger of my lord burn; thou--thou hast known the people that it is in evil;
ylt.32:23: and they say to me, Make for us gods, who go before us, for this Moses--the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt--we have not known what hath happened to him;
ylt.32:24: and I say to them, Whoso hath gold, let them break it off, and they give to me, and I cast it into the fire, and this calf cometh out.'
ylt.32:25: And Moses seeth the people that it is unbridled, for Aaron hath made it unbridled for contempt among its withstanders,
ylt.32:26: and Moses standeth in the gate of the camp, and saith, `Who is for Jehovah? --unto me!' and all the sons of Levi are gathered unto him;
ylt.32:27: and he saith to them, `Thus said Jehovah, God of Israel, Put each his sword by his thigh, pass over and turn back from gate to gate through the camp, and slay each his brother, and each his friend, and each his relation.'
ylt.32:28: And the sons of Levi do according to the word of Moses, and there fall of the people on that day about three thousand men,
ylt.32:29: and Moses saith, `Consecrate your hand to-day to Jehovah, for a man is against his son, and against his brother, so as to bring on you to-day a blessing.'
ylt.32:30: And it cometh to pass, on the morrow, that Moses saith unto the people, `Ye--ye have sinned a great sin, and now I go up unto Jehovah, if so be I atone for your sin.'
ylt.32:31: And Moses turneth back unto Jehovah, and saith, `Oh this people hath sinned a great sin, that they make to themselves a god of gold;
ylt.32:32: and now, if Thou takest away their sin--and if not--blot me, I pray thee, out of Thy book which Thou hast written.'
ylt.32:33: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `Whoso hath sinned against Me--I blot him out of My book;
ylt.32:34: and now, go, lead the people whithersoever I have spoken to thee of; lo, My messenger goeth before thee, and in the day of my charging--then I have charged upon them their sin.'
ylt.32:35: And Jehovah plagueth the people, because they made the calf which Aaron made.
ylt.33:1: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, `Go, ascend from this place, thou and the people, whom thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I have sworn to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, To thy seed I give it,'
ylt.33:2: (and I have sent before thee a messenger, and have cast out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite,)
ylt.33:3: unto a land flowing with milk and honey, for I do not go up in thy midst, for thou art a stiff-necked people--lest I consume thee in the way.'
ylt.33:4: And the people hear this sad thing, and mourn; and none put his ornaments on him.
ylt.33:5: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `Say unto the sons of Israel, Ye are a stiff-necked people; one moment--I come up into thy midst, and have consumed thee; and now, put down thine ornaments from off thee, and I know what I do to thee;'
ylt.33:6: and the sons of Israel take off their ornaments at mount Horeb.
ylt.33:7: And Moses taketh the tent, and hath stretched it out at the outside of the camp, afar off from the camp, and hath called it, `Tent of Meeting;' and it hath come to pass, every one seeking Jehovah goeth out unto the tent of meeting, which is at the outside of the camp.
ylt.33:8: And it hath come to pass, at the going out of Moses unto the tent, all the people rise, and have stood, each at the opening of his tent, and have looked expectingly after Moses, until his going into the tent.
ylt.33:9: And it hath come to pass, at the going in of Moses to the tent, the pillar of the cloud cometh down, and hath stood at the opening of the tent, and He hath spoken with Moses;
ylt.33:10: and all the people have seen the pillar of the cloud standing at the opening of the tent, and all the people have risen and bowed themselves, each at the opening of his tent.
ylt.33:11: And Jehovah hath spoken unto Moses face unto face, as a man speaketh unto his friend; and he hath turned back unto the camp, and his minister Joshua, son of Nun, a youth, departeth not out of the tent.
ylt.33:12: And Moses saith unto Jehovah, `See, Thou art saying unto me, Bring up this people, and Thou hast not caused me to know whom Thou dost send with me; and Thou hast said, I have known thee by name, and also thou hast found grace in Mine eyes.
ylt.33:13: `And now, if, I pray Thee, I have found grace in Thine eyes, cause me to know, I pray Thee, Thy way, and I know Thee, so that I find grace in Thine eyes, and consider that this nation is Thy people;'
ylt.33:14: and He saith, `My presence doth go, and I have given rest to thee.'
ylt.33:15: And he saith unto Him, `If Thy presence is not going--take us not up from this place;
ylt.33:16: and in what is it known now, that I have found grace in Thine eyes--I and Thy people--is it not in Thy going with us? and we have been distinguished--I and Thy people--from all the people who are on the face of the ground.'
ylt.33:17: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `Even this thing which thou hast spoken I do; for thou hast found grace in Mine eyes, and I know thee by name.'
ylt.33:18: And he saith, `Shew me, I pray Thee, Thine honour;'
ylt.33:19: and He saith, `I cause all My goodness to pass before thy face, and have called concerning the Name of Jehovah before thee, and favoured him whom I favour, and loved him whom I love.'
ylt.33:20: He saith also, `Thou art unable to see My face, for man doth not see Me, and live;'
ylt.33:21: Jehovah also saith, `Lo, a place is by Me, and thou hast stood on the rock,
ylt.33:22: and it hath come to pass, in the passing by of Mine honour, that I have set thee in a cleft of the rock, and spread out My hands over thee, until My passing by,
ylt.33:23: and I have turned aside My hands, and thou hast seen My back parts, and My face is not seen.'
ylt.34:1: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `Hew for thyself two tables of stone like the first, and I have written on the tables the words which were on the first tables which thou hast broken;
ylt.34:2: and be prepared at morning, and thou hast come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and hast stood before Me there, on the top of the mount,
ylt.34:3: and no man cometh up with thee, and also no man is seen in all the mount, also the flock and the herd do not feed over-against that mount.'
ylt.34:4: And he heweth two tables of stone like the first, and Moses riseth early in the morning, and goeth up unto mount Sinai, as Jehovah commanded him, and he taketh in his hand two tables of stone.
ylt.34:5: And Jehovah cometh down in a cloud, and stationeth Himself with him there, and calleth in the Name of Jehovah,
ylt.34:6: and Jehovah passeth over before his face, and calleth: `Jehovah, Jehovah God, merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in kindness and truth,
ylt.34:7: keeping kindness for thousands, taking away iniquity, and transgression, and sin, and not entirely acquitting, charging iniquity of fathers on children, and on children's children, on a third generation, and on a fourth.'
ylt.34:8: And Moses hasteth, and boweth to the earth, and doth obeisance,
ylt.34:9: and saith, `If, I pray Thee, I have found grace in Thine eyes, O my Lord, let my Lord, I pray Thee, go in our midst (for it is a stiff-necked people), and thou hast forgiven our iniquity and our sin, and hast inherited us.'
ylt.34:10: And He saith, `Lo, I am making a covenant: before all thy people I do wonders, which have not been done in all the earth, or in any nation, and all the people in whose midst thou art have seen the work of Jehovah, for it is fearful that which I am doing with thee.
ylt.34:11: `Observe for thyself that which I am commanding thee to-day: lo, I am casting out from before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite;
ylt.34:12: take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitant of the land into which thou art going, lest it become a snare in thy midst;
ylt.34:13: for their altars ye break down, and their standing pillars ye shiver, and its shrines ye cut down;
ylt.34:14: for ye do not bow yourselves to another god--for Jehovah, whose name is Zealous, is a zealous God.
ylt.34:15: `Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitant of the land, and they have gone a-whoring after their gods, and have sacrificed to their gods, and one hath called to thee, and thou hast eaten of his sacrifice,
ylt.34:16: and thou hast taken of their daughters to thy sons, and their daughters have gone a-whoring after their gods, and have caused thy sons to go a-whoring after their gods;
ylt.34:17: a molten god thou dost not make to thyself.
ylt.34:18: `The feast of unleavened things thou dost keep; seven days thou dost eat unleavened things, as I have commanded thee, at an appointed time, the month of Abib: for in the month of Abib thou didst come out from Egypt.
ylt.34:19: `All opening a womb are Mine, and every firstling of thy cattle born a male, ox or sheep;
ylt.34:20: and the firstling of an ass thou dost ransom with a lamb; and if thou dost not ransom, then thou hast beheaded it; every first-born of thy sons thou dost ransom, and they do not appear before Me empty.
ylt.34:21: `Six days thou dost work, and on the seventh day thou dost rest; in ploughing-time and in harvest thou dost rest.
ylt.34:22: `And a feast of weeks thou dost observe for thyself; first-fruits of wheat-harvest; and the feast of in-gathering, at the revolution of the year.
ylt.34:23: `Three times in a year do all thy males appear before the Lord Jehovah, God of Israel;
ylt.34:24: for I dispossess nations from before thee, and have enlarged thy border, and no man doth desire thy land in thy going up to appear before Jehovah thy God three times in a year.
ylt.34:25: `Thou dost not slaughter with a fermented thing the blood of My sacrifice; and the sacrifice of the feast of the passover doth not remain till morning:
ylt.34:26: the first of the first-fruits of the land thou dost bring into the house of Jehovah thy God; thou dost not boil a kid in its mother's milk.'
ylt.34:27: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `Write for thyself these words, for, according to the tenor of these words I have made with thee a covenant, and with Israel.'
ylt.34:28: And he is there with Jehovah forty days and forty nights; bread he hath not eaten, and water he hath not drunk; and he writeth on the tables the matters of the covenant--the ten matters.
ylt.34:29: And it cometh to pass, when Moses is coming down from mount Sinai (and the two tables of the testimony are in the hand of Moses in his coming down from the mount), that Moses hath not known that the skin of his face hath shone in His speaking with him,
ylt.34:30: and Aaron seeth--all the sons of Israel also--Moses, and lo, the skin of his face hath shone, and they are afraid of coming nigh unto him.
ylt.34:31: And Moses calleth unto them, and Aaron and all the princes in the company return unto him, and Moses speaketh unto them;
ylt.34:32: and afterwards have all the sons of Israel come nigh, and he chargeth them with all that Jehovah hath spoken with him in mount Sinai.
ylt.34:33: And Moses finisheth speaking with them, and putteth on his face a vail;
ylt.34:34: and in the going in of Moses before Jehovah to speak with Him, he turneth aside the vail until his coming out; and he hath come out and hath spoken unto the sons of Israel that which he is commanded;
ylt.34:35: and the sons of Israel have seen the face of Moses that the skin of the face of Moses hath shone, and Moses hath put back the vail on his face until his going in to speak with Him.
ylt.35:1: And Moses assembleth all the company of the sons of Israel, and saith unto them, `These are the things which Jehovah hath commanded--to do them:
ylt.35:2: Six days is work done, and on the seventh day there is to you a holy day, a sabbath of rest to Jehovah; any who doeth work in it is put to death;
ylt.35:3: ye do not burn a fire in any of your dwellings on the sabbath-day.'
ylt.35:4: And Moses speaketh unto all the company of the sons of Israel, saying, `This is the thing which Jehovah hath commanded, saying,
ylt.35:5: Take ye from among you a heave-offering to Jehovah; every one whose heart is willing doth bring it, --the heave-offering of Jehovah, --gold, and silver, and brass,
ylt.35:6: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and linen, and goats' hair,
ylt.35:7: and rams' skins made red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,
ylt.35:8: and oil for the light, and spices for the anointing oil, and for the spice perfume,
ylt.35:9: and shoham stones, and stones for settings, for an ephod, and for a breastplate.
ylt.35:10: `And all the wise-hearted among you come in, and make all that Jehovah hath commanded:
ylt.35:11: `The tabernacle, its tent, and its covering, its hooks, and its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets,
ylt.35:12: `The ark and its staves, the mercy-seat, and the vail of the covering,
ylt.35:13: `The table and its staves, and all its vessels, and the bread of the presence,
ylt.35:14: `And the candlestick for the light, and its vessels, and its lamps, and the oil for the light,
ylt.35:15: `And the altar of perfume, and its staves, and the anointing oil, and the spice perfume, and the covering of the opening at the opening of the tabernacle,
ylt.35:16: `The altar of burnt-offering and the brazen grate which it hath, its staves, and all its vessels, the laver and its base,
ylt.35:17: `The hangings of the court, its pillars, and their sockets, and the covering of the gate of the court,
ylt.35:18: `The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,
ylt.35:19: `The coloured garments, to do service in the sanctuary, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons to act as priest in.'
ylt.35:20: And all the company of the sons of Israel go out from the presence of Moses,
ylt.35:21: and they come in--every man whom his heart hath lifted up, and every one whom his spirit hath made willing--they have brought in the heave-offering of Jehovah for the work of the tent of meeting, and for all its service, and for the holy garments.
ylt.35:22: And they come in--the men with the women--every willing-hearted one--they have brought in nose-ring, and ear-ring, and seal-ring, and necklace, all golden goods, even every one who hath waved a wave-offering of gold to Jehovah.
ylt.35:23: And every man with whom hath been found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and linen, and goats' hair, and rams' skins made red, and badgers' skins, have brought them in;
ylt.35:24: every one lifting up a heave-offering of silver and brass have brought in the heave-offering of Jehovah; and every one with whom hath been found shittim wood for any work of the service brought it in.
ylt.35:25: And every wise-hearted woman hath spun with her hands, and they bring in yarn, the blue, and the purple, the scarlet, and the linen;
ylt.35:26: and all the women whose heart hath lifted them up in wisdom, have spun the goats' hair.
ylt.35:27: And the princes have brought in the shoham stones, and the stones for settings, for the ephod, and for the breastplate,
ylt.35:28: and the spices, and the oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the spice perfume;
ylt.35:29: every man and woman (whom their heart hath made willing to bring in for all the work which Jehovah commanded to be done by the hand of Moses) of the sons of Israel brought in a willing-offering to Jehovah.
ylt.35:30: And Moses saith unto the sons of Israel, `See, Jehovah hath called by name Bezaleel, son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
ylt.35:31: and He doth fill him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all work,
ylt.35:32: even to devise devices to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
ylt.35:33: and in graving of stones for settings, and in graving of wood to work in any work of design.
ylt.35:34: `And to direct He hath put in his heart, he and Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan;
ylt.35:35: He hath filled them with wisdom of heart to do every work, of engraver, and designer, and embroiderer (in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in linen), and weaver, who do any work, and of designers of designs.
ylt.36:1: And Bezaleel, and Aholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whom Jehovah hath given wisdom and understanding to know to do every work of the service of the sanctuary, have done according to all that Jehovah commanded.
ylt.36:2: And Moses calleth unto Bezaleel, and unto Aholiab, and unto every wise-hearted man in whose heart Jehovah hath given wisdom, every one whom his heart lifted up, to come near unto the work to do it.
ylt.36:3: And they take from before Moses all the heave-offering which the sons of Israel have brought in for the work of the service of the sanctuary to do it; and still they have brought in unto him a willing-offering morning by morning.
ylt.36:4: And all the wise men, who are doing all the work of the sanctuary, come each from his work which they are doing,
ylt.36:5: and speak unto Moses, saying, `The people are multiplying to bring in more than sufficient for the service of the work which Jehovah commanded to make.'
ylt.36:6: And Moses commandeth, and they cause a voice to pass over through the camp, saying, `Let not man or woman make any more work for the heave-offering of the sanctuary;' and the people are restrained from bringing,
ylt.36:7: and the work hath been sufficient for them, for all the work, to do it, and to leave.
ylt.36:8: And all the wise-hearted ones among the doers of the work make the tabernacle; ten curtains of twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubs, work of a designer, he hath made them.
ylt.36:9: The length of the one curtain is eight and twenty by the cubit, and the breadth of the one curtain four by the cubit; one measure is to all the curtains.
ylt.36:10: And he joineth the five curtains one unto another, and the other five curtains he hath joined one unto another;
ylt.36:11: and he maketh loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain, at the end, in the joining; so he hath made in the edge of the outmost curtain, in the joining of the second;
ylt.36:12: fifty loops he hath made in the one curtain, and fifty loops hath he made in the end of the curtain which is in the joining of the second; the loops are taking hold one on another.
ylt.36:13: And he maketh fifty hooks of gold, and joineth the curtains one unto another by the hooks, and the tabernacle is one.
ylt.36:14: And he maketh curtains of goats' hair for a tent over the tabernacle; eleven curtains he hath made them;
ylt.36:15: the length of the one curtain is thirty by the cubit, and the breadth of the one curtain is four cubits; one measure is to the eleven curtains;
ylt.36:16: and he joineth the five curtains apart, and the six curtains apart.
ylt.36:17: And he maketh fifty loops on the outer edge of the curtain, in the joining; and fifty loops he hath made on the edge of the curtain which is joining the second;
ylt.36:18: and he maketh fifty hooks of brass to join the tent--to be one;
ylt.36:19: and he maketh a covering for the tent of rams' skins made red, and a covering of badgers' skins above.
ylt.36:20: And he maketh the boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up;
ylt.36:21: ten cubits is the length of the one board, and a cubit and a half the breadth of the one board;
ylt.36:22: two handles are to the one board, joined one unto another; so he hath made for all the boards of the tabernacle.
ylt.36:23: And he maketh the boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward;
ylt.36:24: and forty sockets of silver he hath made under the twenty boards, two sockets under the one board for its two handles, and two sockets under the other board for its two handles.
ylt.36:25: And for the second side of the tabernacle, for the north side, he hath made twenty boards,
ylt.36:26: and their forty sockets of silver, two sockets under the one board, and two sockets under the other board;
ylt.36:27: and for the sides of the tabernacle, westward, hath he made six boards;
ylt.36:28: and two boards hath he made for the corners of the tabernacle, in the two sides;
ylt.36:29: and they have been twins below, and together they are twins at its head, at the one ring; so he hath done to both of them at the two corners;
ylt.36:30: and there have been eight boards; and their sockets of silver are sixteen sockets, two sockets under the one board.
ylt.36:31: And he maketh bars of shittim wood, five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
ylt.36:32: and five bars for the boards of the second side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle, for the sides westward;
ylt.36:33: and he maketh the middle bar to enter into the midst of the boards from end to end;
ylt.36:34: and the boards he hath overlaid with gold, and their rings he hath made of gold, places for bars, and he overlayeth the bars with gold.
ylt.36:35: And he maketh the vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen, work of a designer he hath made it, with cherubs;
ylt.36:36: and he maketh for it four pillars of shittim wood, and overlayeth them with gold; their pegs are of gold; and he casteth for them four sockets of silver.
ylt.36:37: And he maketh a covering for the opening of the tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen, work of an embroiderer,
ylt.36:38: also its five pillars, and their pegs; and he overlaid their tops and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets are brass.
ylt.37:1: And Bezaleel maketh the ark of shittim wood, two cubits and a half its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height;
ylt.37:2: and he overlayeth it with pure gold within and without, and maketh for it a wreath of gold round about;
ylt.37:3: and he casteth for it four rings of gold, on its four feet, even two rings on its one side, and two rings on its second side;
ylt.37:4: and he maketh staves of shittim wood, and overlayeth them with gold,
ylt.37:5: and he bringeth in the staves into the rings, by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
ylt.37:6: And he maketh a mercy-seat of pure gold, two cubits and a half its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth;
ylt.37:7: and he maketh two cherubs of gold, of beaten work he hath made them, at the two ends of the mercy-seat;
ylt.37:8: one cherub at the end on this side, and one cherub at the end on that, out of the mercy-seat he hath made the cherubs, at its two ends;
ylt.37:9: and the cherubs are spreading out wings on high, covering over the mercy-seat with their wings, and their faces are one towards another; towards the mercy-seat have the faces of the cherubs been.
ylt.37:10: And he maketh the table of shittim wood; two cubits its length, and a cubit its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height,
ylt.37:11: and overlayeth it with pure gold, and maketh for it a wreath of gold round about.
ylt.37:12: And he maketh for it a border of a handbreadth round about, and maketh a wreath of gold for its border round about;
ylt.37:13: and he casteth for it four rings of gold, and putteth the rings on the four corners which are to its four feet;
ylt.37:14: over-against the border have the rings been, places for staves to bear the table.
ylt.37:15: And he maketh the staves of shittim wood, and overlayeth them with gold, to bear the table;
ylt.37:16: and he maketh the vessels which are upon the table, its dishes, and its bowls, and its cups, and the cups by which they pour out, of pure gold.
ylt.37:17: And he maketh the candlestick of pure gold; of beaten work he hath made the candlestick, its base, and its branch, its calyxes, its knops, and its flowers, have been of the same;
ylt.37:18: and six branches are coming out of its sides, three branches of the candlestick out of its one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of its second side;
ylt.37:19: three calyxes, made like almonds, in the one branch, a knop and a flower; and three calyxes, made like almonds, in another branch, a knop and a flower; so to the six branches which are coming out of the candlestick.
ylt.37:20: And in the candlestick are four calyxes, made like almonds, its knops, and its flowers,
ylt.37:21: and a knop under the two branches of the same, and a knop under the two branches of the same, and a knop under the two branches of the same, are to the six branches which are coming out of it;
ylt.37:22: their knops and their branches have been of the same; all of it one beaten work of pure gold.
ylt.37:23: And he maketh its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff-dishes, of pure gold;
ylt.37:24: of a talent of pure gold he hath made it, and all its vessels.
ylt.37:25: And he maketh the perfume-altar of shittim wood; a cubit its length, and a cubit its breadth (square), and two cubits its height; its horns have been of the same;
ylt.37:26: and he overlayeth it with pure gold, its top and its sides round about, and its horns; and he maketh for it a wreath of gold round about;
ylt.37:27: and two rings of gold he hath made for it under its wreath, at its two corners, at its two sides, for places for staves to bear it with them.
ylt.37:28: And he maketh the staves of shittim wood, and overlayeth them with gold;
ylt.37:29: and he maketh the holy anointing oil, and the pure spice-perfume--work of a compounder.
ylt.38:1: And he maketh the altar of burnt-offering of shittim wood, five cubits its length, and five cubits its breadth (square), and three cubits its height;
ylt.38:2: and he maketh its horns on its four corners; its horns have been of the same; and he overlayeth it with brass;
ylt.38:3: and he maketh all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the sprinkling-pans, the forks, and the fire-pans; all its vessels he hath made of brass.
ylt.38:4: And he maketh for the altar a brazen grate of net-work, under its border beneath, unto its midst;
ylt.38:5: and he casteth four rings for the four ends of the brazen grate--places for bars;
ylt.38:6: and he maketh the staves of shittim wood, and overlayeth them with brass;
ylt.38:7: and he bringeth in the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it with them; hollow with boards he made it.
ylt.38:8: And he maketh the laver of brass, and its base of brass, with the looking-glasses of the women assembling, who have assembled at the opening of the tent of meeting.
ylt.38:9: And he maketh the court; at the south side southward, the hangings of the court of twined linen, a hundred by the cubit,
ylt.38:10: their pillars are twenty, and their brazen sockets twenty, the pegs of the pillars and their fillets are silver;
ylt.38:11: and at the north side, a hundred by the cubit, their pillars are twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the pegs of the pillars and their fillets are silver;
ylt.38:12: and at the west side are hangings, fifty by the cubit; their pillars are ten, and their sockets ten; the pegs of the pillars and their fillets are silver;
ylt.38:13: and at the east side eastward fifty cubits.
ylt.38:14: The hangings on the side are fifteen cubits, their pillars three, and their sockets three,
ylt.38:15: and at the second side at the gate of the court, on this and on that, are hangings, fifteen cubits, their pillars three, and their sockets three;
ylt.38:16: all the hangings of the court round about are of twined linen,
ylt.38:17: and the sockets for the pillars of brass, the pegs of the pillars and their fillets of silver, and the overlaying of their tops of silver, and all the pillars of the court are filleted with silver.
ylt.38:18: And the covering of the gate of the court is the work of an embroiderer, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen; and twenty cubits is the length, and the height with the breadth five cubits, over-against the hangings of the court;
ylt.38:19: and their pillars are four, and their sockets of brass four, their pegs are of silver, and the overlaying of their tops and their fillets are of silver;
ylt.38:20: and all the pins for the tabernacle, and for the court round about, are of brass.
ylt.38:21: These are the numberings of the tabernacle (the tabernacle of testimony), which hath been numbered by the command of Moses, the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
ylt.38:22: And Bezaleel son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, hath made all that Jehovah commanded Moses;
ylt.38:23: and with him is Aholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and designer, and embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and in linen.
ylt.38:24: All the gold which is prepared for the work in all the work of the sanctuary (and it is the gold of the wave-offering) is twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary.
ylt.38:25: And the silver of those numbered of the company is a hundred talents, and a thousand and seven hundred and five and seventy shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary;
ylt.38:26: a bekah for a poll (half a shekel, by the shekel of the sanctuary,) for every one who is passing over unto those numbered, from a son of twenty years and upwards, for six hundred thousand, and three thousand, and five hundred and fifty.
ylt.38:27: And a hundred talents of silver are to cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; a hundred sockets for the hundred talents, a talent for a socket;
ylt.38:28: and the thousand and seven hundred and five and seventy he hath made pegs for the pillars, and overlaid their tops, and filleted them.
ylt.38:29: And the brass of the wave-offering is seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels;
ylt.38:30: and he maketh with it the sockets of the opening of the tent of meeting, and the brazen altar, and the brazen grate which it hath, and all the vessels of the altar,
ylt.38:31: and the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the gate of the court, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.
ylt.39:1: And of the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, they made coloured garments, to minister in the sanctuary; and they make the holy garments which are for Aaron, as Jehovah hath commanded Moses.
ylt.39:2: And he maketh the ephod, of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen,
ylt.39:3: and they expand the plates of gold, and have cut off wires to work in the midst of the blue, and in the midst of the purple, and in the midst of the scarlet, and in the midst of the linen--work of a designer;
ylt.39:4: shoulder-pieces they have made for it, joining; at its two ends it is joined.
ylt.39:5: And the girdle of his ephod which is on it is of the same, according to its work, of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen, as Jehovah hath commanded Moses.
ylt.39:6: And they prepare the shoham stones, set, embroidered with gold, opened with openings of a signet, by the names of the sons of Israel;
ylt.39:7: and he setteth them on the shoulders of the ephod--stones of memorial for the sons of Israel, as Jehovah hath commanded Moses.
ylt.39:8: And he maketh the breastplate, work of a designer, like the work of the ephod, of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen;
ylt.39:9: it hath been square; double they have made the breastplate, a span its length, and a span its breadth, doubled.
ylt.39:10: And they fill in it four rows of stones; a row of a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle is the one row;
ylt.39:11: and the second row an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond;
ylt.39:12: and the third row an opal, an agate, and an amethyst;
ylt.39:13: and the fourth row a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper--set, embroidered with gold, in their settings.
ylt.39:14: And the stones, according to the names of the sons of Israel, are twelve, according to their names, openings of a signet, each according to his name, for the twelve tribes.
ylt.39:15: And they make on the breastplate wreathed chains, work of thick bands, of pure gold;
ylt.39:16: and they make two embroidered things of gold, and two rings of gold, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate,
ylt.39:17: and they put the two thick bands of gold on the two rings on the ends of the breastplate;
ylt.39:18: and the two ends of the two thick bands they have put on the two embroidered things, and they put them on the shoulders of the ephod, over-against its front.
ylt.39:19: And they make two rings of gold, and set them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its border, which is on the side of the ephod within;
ylt.39:20: and they make two rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulders of the ephod below, over-against its front, over-against its joining, above the girdle of the ephod;
ylt.39:21: and they bind the breastplate by its rings unto the rings of the ephod, with a ribbon of blue, to be above the girdle of the ephod, and the breastplate is not loosed from off the ephod, as Jehovah hath commanded Moses.
ylt.39:22: And he maketh the upper robe of the ephod, work of a weaver, completely of blue;
ylt.39:23: and the opening of the upper robe is in its midst, as the opening of a habergeon, a border is to its opening round about, it is not rent;
ylt.39:24: and they make on the hems of the upper robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, twined.
ylt.39:25: And they make bells of pure gold, and put the bells in the midst of the pomegranates, on the hems of the upper robe, round about, in the midst of the pomegranates;
ylt.39:26: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, are on the hems of the upper robe, round about, to minister in, as Jehovah hath commanded Moses.
ylt.39:27: And they make the coats of linen, work of a weaver, for Aaron and for his sons,
ylt.39:28: and the mitre of linen, and the beautiful bonnets of linen, and the linen trousers, of twined linen,
ylt.39:29: and the girdle of twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, work of an embroiderer, as Jehovah hath commanded Moses.
ylt.39:30: And they make the flower of the holy crown of pure gold, and write on it a writing, openings of a signet, `Holy to Jehovah;'
ylt.39:31: and they put on it a ribbon of blue, to put it on the mitre above, as Jehovah hath commanded Moses.
ylt.39:32: And all the service of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting is completed; and the sons of Israel do according to all that Jehovah hath commanded Moses; so they have done.
ylt.39:33: And they bring in the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all its vessels, its hooks, its boards, its bars, and its pillars, and its sockets;
ylt.39:34: and the covering of rams' skins, which are made red, and the covering of badgers' skins, and the vail of the covering;
ylt.39:35: the ark of the testimony and its staves, and the mercy-seat;
ylt.39:36: the table, all its vessels, and the bread of the presence;
ylt.39:37: the pure candlestick, its lamps, the lamps of arrangement, and all its vessels, and the oil for the light.
ylt.39:38: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the spice-perfume, and the covering of the opening of the tent;
ylt.39:39: the brazen altar and the brazen grate which it hath, its staves, and all its vessels, the laver and its base.
ylt.39:40: The hangings of the court, its pillars, and its sockets; and the covering for the gate of the court, its cords, and its pins; and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of meeting;
ylt.39:41: the coloured clothes to minister in the sanctuary, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to act as priest in.
ylt.39:42: According to all that Jehovah hath commanded Moses, so have the sons of Israel done all the service;
ylt.39:43: and Moses seeth all the work, and lo, they have done it as Jehovah hath commanded; so they have done. And Moses doth bless them.
ylt.40:1: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
ylt.40:2: `On the first day of the month, in the first month, thou dost raise up the tabernacle of the tent of meeting,
ylt.40:3: and hast set there the ark of the testimony, and hast covered over the ark with the vail,
ylt.40:4: and hast brought in the table, and set its arrangement in order, and hast brought in the candlestick, and caused its lamps to go up.
ylt.40:5: `And thou hast put the golden altar for perfume before the ark of the testimony, and hast put the covering of the opening to the tabernacle,
ylt.40:6: and hast put the altar of the burnt-offering before the opening of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting,
ylt.40:7: and hast put the laver between the tent of meeting and the altar, and hast put water there.
ylt.40:8: `And thou hast set the court round about, and hast placed the covering of the gate of the court,
ylt.40:9: and hast taken the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle, and all that is in it, and hallowed it, and all its vessels, and it hath been holy;
ylt.40:10: and thou hast anointed the altar of the burnt-offering, and all its vessels, and sanctified the altar, and the altar hath been most holy;
ylt.40:11: and thou hast anointed the laver and its base, and sanctified it.
ylt.40:12: `And thou hast brought near Aaron and his sons unto the opening of the tent of meeting, and hast bathed them with water;
ylt.40:13: and thou hast clothed Aaron with the holy garments, and anointed him, and sanctified him, and he hath acted as priest to Me.
ylt.40:14: `And his sons thou dost bring near, and hast clothed them with coats,
ylt.40:15: and anointed them as thou hast anointed their father, and they have acted as priests to Me, and their anointing hath been to be to them for a priesthood age-during, to their generations.'
ylt.40:16: And Moses doth according to all that Jehovah hath commanded him; so he hath done.
ylt.40:17: And it cometh to pass, in the first month, in the second year, in the first of the month, the tabernacle hath been raised up;
ylt.40:18: and Moses raiseth up the tabernacle, and setteth its sockets, and placeth its boards, and placeth its bars, and raiseth its pillars,
ylt.40:19: and spreadeth the tent over the tabernacle, and putteth the covering of the tent upon it above, as Jehovah hath commanded Moses.
ylt.40:20: And he taketh and putteth the testimony unto the ark, and setteth the staves on the ark, and putteth the mercy-seat on the ark above;
ylt.40:21: and bringeth in the ark unto the tabernacle, and placeth the vail of the covering, and covereth over the ark of the testimony, as Jehovah hath commanded Moses.
ylt.40:22: And he putteth the table in the tent of meeting, on the side of the tabernacle northward, at the outside of the vail,
ylt.40:23: and setteth in order upon it the arrangement of bread, before Jehovah, as Jehovah hath commanded Moses.
ylt.40:24: And he putteth the candlestick in the tent of meeting, over-against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward,
ylt.40:25: and causeth the lamps to go up before Jehovah, as Jehovah hath commanded Moses.
ylt.40:26: And he setteth the golden altar in the tent of meeting, before the vail,
ylt.40:27: and maketh perfume on it--spice-perfume--as Jehovah hath commanded Moses.
ylt.40:28: And he setteth the covering of the opening to the tabernacle,
ylt.40:29: and the altar of the burnt-offering he hath set at the opening of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and causeth the burnt-offering to go up upon it, and the present, as Jehovah hath commanded Moses.
ylt.40:30: And he putteth the laver between the tent of meeting and the altar, and putteth water there for washing,
ylt.40:31: and Moses and Aaron and his sons have washed their hands and their feet at the same;
ylt.40:32: in their going in unto the tent of meeting, and in their drawing near unto the altar, they wash, as Jehovah hath commanded Moses.
ylt.40:33: And he raiseth up the court round about the tabernacle, and about the altar, and placeth the covering of the gate of the court; and Moses completeth the work.
ylt.40:34: And the cloud covereth the tent of meeting, and the honour of Jehovah hath filled the tabernacle;
ylt.40:35: and Moses hath not been able to go in unto the tent of meeting, for the cloud hath tabernacled on it, and the honour of Jehovah hath filled the tabernacle.
ylt.40:36: And in the going up of the cloud from off the tabernacle the sons of Israel journey in all their journeys;
ylt.40:37: and if the cloud go not up then they journey not, until the day of its going up:
ylt.40:38: for the cloud of Jehovah is on the tabernacle by day, and fire is in it by night, before the eyes of all the house of Israel in all their journeys.

web.1:1: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel, who came into Egypt (every man and his household came with Jacob):
web.1:4: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
web.1:5: All the souls who came out of Jacob’s body were seventy souls, and Joseph was in Egypt already.
web.1:6: Joseph died, as did all his brothers, and all that generation.
web.1:7: The children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and grew exceedingly mighty; and the land was filled with them.
web.1:8: Now there arose a new king over Egypt, who didn’t know Joseph.
web.1:9: He said to his people, “Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we.
web.1:10: Come, let’s deal wisely with them, lest they multiply, and it happen that when any war breaks out, they also join themselves to our enemies and fight against us, and escape out of the land.”
web.1:11: Therefore they set taskmasters over them to afflict them with their burdens. They built storage cities for Pharaoh: Pithom and Raamses.
web.1:12: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and the more they spread out. They started to dread the children of Israel.
web.1:13: The Egyptians ruthlessly made the children of Israel serve,
web.1:14: and they made their lives bitter with hard service in mortar and in brick, and in all kinds of service in the field, all their service, in which they ruthlessly made them serve.
web.1:15: The king of Egypt spoke to the Hebrew midwives, of whom the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah,
web.1:16: and he said, “When you perform the duty of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them on the birth stool, if it is a son, then you shall kill him; but if it is a daughter, then she shall live.”
web.1:17: But the midwives feared God, and didn’t do what the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the baby boys alive.
web.1:18: The king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said to them, “Why have you done this thing and saved the boys alive?”
web.1:19: The midwives said to Pharaoh, “Because the Hebrew women aren’t like the Egyptian women; for they are vigorous and give birth before the midwife comes to them.”
web.1:20: God dealt well with the midwives, and the people multiplied, and grew very mighty.
web.1:21: Because the midwives feared God, he gave them families.
web.1:22: Pharaoh commanded all his people, saying, “You shall cast every son who is born into the river, and every daughter you shall save alive.”
web.2:1: A man of the house of Levi went and took a daughter of Levi as his wife.
web.2:2: The woman conceived and bore a son. When she saw that he was a fine child, she hid him three months.
web.2:3: When she could no longer hide him, she took a papyrus basket for him, and coated it with tar and with pitch. She put the child in it, and laid it in the reeds by the river’s bank.
web.2:4: His sister stood far off, to see what would be done to him.
web.2:5: Pharaoh’s daughter came down to bathe at the river. Her maidens walked along by the riverside. She saw the basket among the reeds, and sent her servant to get it.
web.2:6: She opened it, and saw the child, and behold, the baby cried. She had compassion on him, and said, “This is one of the Hebrews’ children.”
web.2:7: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Should I go and call a nurse for you from the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for you?”
web.2:8: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Go.” The young woman went and called the child’s mother.
web.2:9: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child away, and nurse him for me, and I will give you your wages.” The woman took the child, and nursed it.
web.2:10: The child grew, and she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses, and said, “Because I drew him out of the water.”
web.2:11: In those days, when Moses had grown up, he went out to his brothers and saw their burdens. He saw an Egyptian striking a Hebrew, one of his brothers.
web.2:12: He looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no one, he killed the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.
web.2:13: He went out the second day, and behold, two men of the Hebrews were fighting with each other. He said to him who did the wrong, “Why do you strike your fellow?”
web.2:14: He said, “Who made you a prince and a judge over us? Do you plan to kill me, as you killed the Egyptian?” Moses was afraid, and said, “Surely this thing is known.”
web.2:15: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to kill Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and lived in the land of Midian, and he sat down by a well.
web.2:16: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters. They came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.
web.2:17: The shepherds came and drove them away; but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
web.2:18: When they came to Reuel, their father, he said, “How is it that you have returned so early today?”
web.2:19: They said, “An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and moreover he drew water for us, and watered the flock.”
web.2:20: He said to his daughters, “Where is he? Why is it that you have left the man? Call him, that he may eat bread.”
web.2:21: Moses was content to dwell with the man. He gave Moses Zipporah, his daughter.
web.2:22: She bore a son, and he named him Gershom, for he said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land.”
web.2:23: In the course of those many days, the king of Egypt died, and the children of Israel sighed because of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up to God because of the bondage.
web.2:24: God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
web.2:25: God saw the children of Israel, and God was concerned about them.
web.3:1: Now Moses was keeping the flock of Jethro, his father-in-law, the priest of Midian, and he led the flock to the back of the wilderness, and came to God’s mountain, to Horeb.
web.3:2: Yahweh’s angel appeared to him in a flame of fire out of the middle of a bush. He looked, and behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.
web.3:3: Moses said, “I will go now, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burned.”
web.3:4: When Yahweh saw that he came over to see, God called to him out of the middle of the bush, and said, “Moses! Moses!” He said, “Here I am.”
web.3:5: He said, “Don’t come close. Take off your sandals, for the place you are standing on is holy ground.”
web.3:6: Moreover he said, “I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.” Moses hid his face because he was afraid to look at God.
web.3:7: Yahweh said, “I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of their taskmasters, for I know their sorrows.
web.3:8: I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land to a good and large land, to a land flowing with milk and honey; to the place of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
web.3:9: Now, behold, the cry of the children of Israel has come to me. Moreover I have seen the oppression with which the Egyptians oppress them.
web.3:10: Come now therefore, and I will send you to Pharaoh, that you may bring my people, the children of Israel, out of Egypt.”
web.3:11: Moses said to God, “Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh, and that I should bring the children of Israel out of Egypt?”
web.3:12: He said, “Certainly I will be with you. This will be the token to you, that I have sent you: when you have brought the people out of Egypt, you shall serve God on this mountain.”
web.3:13: Moses said to God, “Behold, when I come to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me to you,’ and they ask me, ‘What is his name?’ what should I tell them?”
web.3:14: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM,” and he said, “You shall tell the children of Israel this: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’ ”
web.3:15: God said moreover to Moses, “You shall tell the children of Israel this, ‘Yahweh, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has sent me to you.’ This is my name forever, and this is my memorial to all generations.
web.3:16: Go and gather the elders of Israel together, and tell them, ‘Yahweh, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, has appeared to me, saying, “I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt.
web.3:17: I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt to the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, to a land flowing with milk and honey.” ’
web.3:18: They will listen to your voice. You shall come, you and the elders of Israel, to the king of Egypt, and you shall tell him, ‘Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Now please let us go three days’ journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to Yahweh, our God.’
web.3:19: I know that the king of Egypt won’t give you permission to go, no, not by a mighty hand.
web.3:20: I will reach out my hand and strike Egypt with all my wonders which I will do among them, and after that he will let you go.
web.3:21: I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, and it will happen that when you go, you shall not go empty-handed.
web.3:22: But every woman shall ask of her neighbor, and of her who visits her house, jewels of silver, jewels of gold, and clothing. You shall put them on your sons, and on your daughters. You shall plunder the Egyptians.”
web.4:1: Moses answered, “But, behold, they will not believe me, nor listen to my voice; for they will say, ‘Yahweh has not appeared to you.’ ”
web.4:2: Yahweh said to him, “What is that in your hand?” He said, “A rod.”
web.4:3: He said, “Throw it on the ground.” He threw it on the ground, and it became a snake; and Moses ran away from it.
